name: Fear-greed velocity crash — flush (not drift) as the contrarian trigger (long)
rationale: MECHANISM: overreaction concentrates in the SPEED of the sentiment move, not the level — a fear_greed that PLUNGES marks panic-in-progress where forced sellers are actively hitting bids, versus a slow grind to extreme fear that is fully anticipated and does NOT snap back. This separates 'flush' from 'grinding bear'. We express the crash as fear_greed CROSSING DOWN through a fitted level on the bar (a fresh break, not a standing low) confirmed by a sharp same-window price drop (ret_Nd), and require realized vol elevated (vol_realized above a fitted floor) so we only act inside an actual liquidity vacuum. Counterparty: patient capital absorbing transient forced flow. Long the snapback; exit on fear relief or time. DISCONFIRMER: regress forward return on fear LEVEL vs the cross event jointly — if the standing level dominates and the fresh break carries no independent sign, this collapses into the level spec (hh-01) and is a duplicate; kill. Also: fear_greed partly embeds price/vol momentum, so verify the velocity is orthogonal to vol_realized (not just realized-vol under another name) or kill.
catalyst: a violent fear_greed plunge into a high-volatility flush
